papers.title: Competition intensity and business model innovation: The distinctive role of strategic innovation readiness in European family and non-family SMEs
papers.abstract: This study proposes and tests a model that extends the knowledge of business model innovation (BMI)'s drivers, introducing strategic innovation readiness (SIR) as a fundamental mediating mechanism. Drawing on the Resource-Based View theory and the Socioemotional Wealth approach, we test the contingent relationship between competition intensity (CI) and BMI in European family and non-family SMEs. Our results confirm that CI influences BMI through SIR. The specific study also reveals that the mediating role of SIR in CI-BMI is moderated by ownership type: the mediating effect is stronger for family SMEs than for non-family SMEs, which are more likely to engage in BMI when competition intensifies.
papers.summary_ja: 競争激度がビジネスモデルイノベーション（BMI）を促進するメカニズムとして「戦略的イノベーション準備状態（SIR）」を媒介変数として特定し、欧州ファミリー企業とノンファミリー企業のSMEを比較した実証研究。ファミリー企業ではSIRを通じたBMIへの影響がより強く働くことが示された。
papers.analysis_unit: 欧州のファミリー企業・非ファミリー企業SMEの質問票調査（標本規模の記載なし）

papers.title: Transforming intermediaries to accelerate sustainability transitions: The case of the World Bank Group and clean energy technology deployment
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the roles and evolution of incumbent intermediaries in sustainability transitions, focusing on the World Bank Group (WBG) and its support for renewable energy technologies in developing countries. We propose a framework analyzing how 'fitness'—the alignment between technology capabilities and institutional support—evolves over time and across geographies. Our findings reveal that the WBG's intermediary roles shift from provision to shaping, brokering, and eventually advocacy—driven by changes in market conditions, institutional pressure, and organizational learning. We conclude with implications for transition governance and intermediary theory.
papers.summary_ja: 世界銀行グループを事例に、中間組織（インターミディアリ）が持続可能性転換において技術・制度的「適合性」の変化に応じて提供→形成→仲介→アドボカシーへと役割転換するプロセスを解明し、転換ガバナンスへの示唆を提供した研究。
papers.analysis_unit: 世界銀行グループ1機関の事例研究（再生可能エネルギー支援の経時的変化）

papers.title: Open user innovation, producer innovation and industrial dynamics: An ABM approach
papers.abstract: This paper sets out to develop a unified theoretical framework integrating von Hippel user innovation and Schumpeterian industrial dynamics through a relatively simple agent-based model (ABM). The model reproduces known stylised facts, and it also generates some important theoretical results to explain how user innovation complements producer innovation in shaping industrial dynamics. In particular, we show how user innovation can play a disruptive role in incumbent industries, how open source user innovation can provide the base for new industries, and how the balance between producer and user innovation affects industrial structures.
papers.summary_ja: エージェントベースモデル（ABM）によってフォン・ヒッペルのユーザーイノベーション論とシュンペーターの産業ダイナミクス論を統合した理論研究。ユーザーイノベーションが既存産業を破壊し、オープンソース型ユーザーイノベーションが新産業の基盤を形成するメカニズムを解明した。
papers.analysis_unit: エージェントベースモデル（ABM）によるシミュレーション研究

papers.title: Design Thinking in Practice: Lessons from Context-Sensitive Implementation in SMEs
papers.abstract: This study explores how Design Thinking is implemented in practice within small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and which contextual factors shape its success. It addresses the research question of how Design Thinking is implemented in SMEs and what contextual factors influence its outcomes. Using semi-structured expert interviews with seven Design Thinking consultants, the study employs a qualitative, exploratory design and applies the Gioia methodology for inductive analysis. The analysis identifies six thematic dimensions that explain how Design Thinking becomes actionable in SMEs, ranging from strategic alignment to long-term embedding. The findings show that effective SME adoption of Design Thinking hinges on leadership commitment, early managerial involvement, and cross-functional collaboration, and is characterized by pragmatic adaptations such as shorter workshop formats distributed over several weeks, low-cost prototyping (sketches, mock-ups, simple digital artefacts), and an iterative, context-sensitive integration into everyday routines rather than adherence to linear stage models. Sustainability (in terms of organizational capacity and resilience) frequently emerges as a secondary outcome rather than a predefined objective. These practices enable SMEs to manage operational constraints while achieving user-centric problem framing and faster learning loops. The study contributes to the growing body of research on innovation management in SMEs by providing an empirically grounded account of SME-specific Design Thinking adaptations and offering actionable implications for managers, consultants, and policymakers.
papers.summary_ja: デザインシンキング・コンサルタント7名への専門家インタビューをGioia法で分析し、SMEでDTが機能する条件を6つの集約ディメンションとして整理。経営層のコミットメント・早期の管理職関与・部門横断の協働が鍵であり、短縮ワークショップの分散開催や低コストプロトタイピングといった現実的な適応が実装を支えることを質的に明らかにした。
papers.analysis_unit: デザインシンキング・コンサルタント7名への半構造化専門家インタビュー

papers.title: Diffusing transformative innovations through templating – The case of onsite water reuse in the United States
papers.abstract: Although transitions literature provides ample evidence of how transformative innovations like renewable energies, regenerative agriculture, or multi-modal mobility systems emerge, it offers limited insight into the mechanisms that enable their spatial diffusion. We address this gap by exploring templating as a mechanism through which innovations diffuse spatially without losing their transformative potential. Through an in-depth qualitative study of onsite water reuse technology in the United States, we find that templating involves three key activities: abstraction, encoding, and instantiation. We also find that strategic framing is key to prevent institutional lock-in while maintaining the innovation's value proposition.
papers.summary_ja: 変革的イノベーション（現地水資源再利用技術）の空間的普及を可能にする「テンプレーティング」メカニズムを発見した定性研究。抽象化・符号化・実体化という3段階の活動と戦略的フレーミングが制度的ロックインを回避しながら変革的価値を維持することを実証した。
papers.analysis_unit: 米国のオンサイト水再利用技術を対象とした深層質的研究（標本規模の記載なし）

papers.title: Circularity and Resilience in Entrepreneurial Ecosystems in Times of Crisis
papers.abstract: Despite recent efforts to bridge the circular economy and entrepreneurship, and to explore resilience in entrepreneurial ecosystems, the ways in which startups' circularity orientations influence how they build resilience in times of crisis remain unclear. Drawing on the adaptive cycle model and entrepreneurial ecosystem theory, this study examines how circularity orientation shapes the ecosystem-level adaptive responses during times of crisis. The study is based on a qualitative analysis of Norwegian startups in the circular economy and explores their ecosystem-level collaborative strategies during the COVID-19 pandemic. Our findings show that circularity orientations shape adaptive resilience processes through three mechanisms: resource diversification, collaborative reconfiguration, and institutional mobilization.
papers.summary_ja: COVID-19危機時のノルウェーのサーキュラー系スタートアップを対象に、サーキュラリティ指向が企業家エコシステムの回復力をどう形成するかを分析した研究。資源多様化・協働的再構成・制度的動員の3メカニズムを通じた適応的回復力プロセスを明らかにした。
papers.analysis_unit: ノルウェーの循環経済スタートアップの質的分析（標本規模の記載なし）

papers.title: How Does Predictive AI Create Business Value? A Configurational Analysis From a Task-Technology Fit Perspective
papers.abstract: This paper investigates how AI integrators drive business value across organisational contexts by leveraging predictive AI to reduce uncertainty. We integrate the task-technology fit (TTF) framework with context-mechanism-outcome (CMO) logic to explain how AI integrators align predictive AI capabilities with tasks. Using qualitative comparative analysis (QCA) on data from 40 Spanish organisations, we identify the configurations of conditions (AI investments, relational capabilities, and organisational agility) that enable AI integrators to create business value through three pathways: efficiency-driven, innovation-driven, and resilience-driven.
papers.summary_ja: タスク技術適合（TTF）フレームワークとCMOロジックを統合し、QCA（定性的比較分析）によってスペイン企業40社を分析した研究。AI投資・関係性能力・組織アジリティの組み合わせが効率駆動・イノベーション駆動・レジリエンス駆動の3経路でビジネス価値を生み出すことを特定した。
papers.analysis_unit: スペインの組織40件のデータによる質的比較分析（QCA）

papers.title: Resilience in service innovation ecosystems: adaptive capacities, co-creation and institutional agility amid external shocks
papers.journal: Journal of Service Theory and Practice
papers.abstract: The study seeks to explain how service innovation ecosystems (SIEs) develop resilience when confronted with external shocks. Using a mixed-methods approach combining systematic literature review and primary case study research across healthcare, fintech, and smart city sectors, this study identifies adaptive capacities and institutional agility as the key drivers of SIE resilience, with co-creation serving as the enabling mechanism. The findings reveal three resilience archetypes: absorptive, adaptive, and transformative—each activated by different actor configurations and governance structures within the SIE.
papers.summary_ja: サービスイノベーションエコシステム（SIE）が外部ショックに対して回復力を構築するメカニズムを混合研究法で分析した研究。適応能力と制度的アジリティが鍵であり、共創がその実現メカニズムであることを示した上で、吸収型・適応型・変革型の3つの回復力アーキタイプを提案した。

papers.title: Is the glass half full or half empty? Underestimating versus overestimating institutional distance and the importance of managerial cognition
papers.abstract: This study explores how managerial misperceptions of institutional distance, specifically, the underestimation and overestimation of formal and informal institutional differences between home and host markets, shape expansion strategies, in particular location choice. It examines the moderating roles of prior international experience and environmental dynamism in these relationships. We test our hypotheses with a dataset of 1,200 cross-border acquisition decisions by Nordic multinational enterprises (MNEs), using a novel approach to measure cognitive biases in location choice. Our results show that firms that underestimate institutional distance are more likely to choose culturally distant markets, while those that overestimate it tend to cluster around familiar markets.
papers.summary_ja: 制度的距離の過小・過大評価という管理者の認知的バイアスが北欧多国籍企業1,200件の越境M&A意思決定に与える影響を分析した実証研究。国際経験がバイアスを緩和し、環境ダイナミズムが過大評価の影響を増幅することが明らかになった。
papers.analysis_unit: 北欧多国籍企業のクロスボーダー買収意思決定1,200件のデータセット

papers.title: Does Modularity Coordinate? Disentangling Decoupling, Interface Standardization, and Hierarchy Governance in Platform Ecosystems
papers.abstract: Modularity undergirds every contemporary platform, yet the contestation of its coordinative capacity conflates complementarity, interfaces, and architecture. We disentangle three distinct mechanisms through which modularity coordinates: (1) decoupling—enabling parallel development by reducing interdependencies; (2) interface standardization—enabling interoperability by fixing interaction protocols; and (3) hierarchy governance—enabling system integrity by structuring authority relations. Using a comparative case study of four major digital platform ecosystems (iOS/App Store, Android/Play Store, Salesforce, and Kubernetes), we show that each mechanism operates through distinct governance logics, has characteristic failure modes, and requires different orchestration strategies.
papers.summary_ja: iOS・Android・Salesforce・Kubernetesの4大プラットフォームエコシステムの比較事例から、モジュラリティの調整機能を「デカップリング」「インターフェース標準化」「階層ガバナンス」の3メカニズムに分解し、それぞれ固有の失敗パターンとオーケストレーション戦略があることを示した理論研究。
papers.analysis_unit: 主要デジタルプラットフォームエコシステム4件の比較事例研究
